enrich.rationale: Residual-UCB active enrichment will directly add samples in the model’s empirically weak regions, giving the best chance of reducing RMSE toward the target per new solve.

diagnosis: The surrogate remains sample-bottlenecked with strongly input-correlated residual structure (r0/a/kappa/delta/Ip) while split variance is low, indicating missing coverage in specific regions rather than tuning noise.
